subjects.name: Genesis II Church of Health and Healing

summary: Follow-up on the Genesis II Church, a Florida group selling industrial bleach (MMS) as a cure-all, as it pitched the chemical as a COVID-19 cure in 2020, seized on Trump's disinfectant remarks and was sued by the FDA.

evidence.note: framed as an update on the church covered in an earlier two-parter, prompted by recent news
Grenon introduced as Humble's assistant who now effectively runs the church
US government sues the church under the Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act over COVID cure claims
temporary injunction granted by federal court in the Southern District of Florida
Rivera's Telegram advice to parents on dosing children with bleach enemas and baths
Keyes met the Grenons in 2018 and began promoting MMS on his network
brief segment on Keyes and Sisson distributing chlorine dioxide in Uganda

notes: Transcript spells the names Grennan and Carrie Rivera; used the standard spellings Mark Grenon and Kerri Rivera. Grenon's birth year not given, so floruit used. Uganda segment is only a few minutes, kept as keyword rather than setting. Keyes's earlier career is background only.
